title: EF Core IDbCommandInterceptor
subtitle: Intercepting SQL queries dynamically for automatic multi-tenancy and soft delete.
post_text:
Day 8/30 — EF Core IDbCommandInterceptor (.NET & C#)

Stop cluttering every LINQ query with manual `.Where(t => t.TenantId == id)` filters that developers inevitably forget.

• **Command Manipulation:** Rewrites the underlying SQL text right before database dispatch.
• **Global Safety:** Enforces tenancy and soft delete rules at the database driver boundary.
• **Memory Efficiency:** Avoids Expression Tree recompilation overhead on hot execution paths.

Watch out: Mutating SQL strings via regex can break execution plans and bypass query cache.

How do you handle multi-tenancy in your repositories?
